note.zh-TW: 現行台灣報表稱為綜合損益表，多了其他綜合損益的部分，本課不教。
note.en: Current Taiwanese statements are titled statement of comprehensive income, which adds other comprehensive income; this course does not cover that part.

definition.zh-TW: 一段期間的經營成績單。最上面是這段期間賣出商品或服務的營業收入，往下一層一層減掉商品成本、銷管費用、業外收支與所得稅，每減一次就得到一層利益，最後一層是本期淨利。因為算的是一段期間的累計，標題寫的是起訖日期。
definition.en: The scorecard for a period of trading. Revenue from the goods or services sold during the period sits at the top; cost of sales, distribution costs and administrative expenses, non-operating items and income tax are then deducted one layer at a time, each deduction producing a profit level, down to profit for the period at the bottom. Because it accumulates a span of time, its heading shows a start date and an end date.
